name: feature-bento
title: Feature Bento Grid
description: A bento feature grid on a pale page: one large mountain photo card with a headline, plus smaller tiles for a statistic, a feature, a pass call to action and two more numbers.
use: Several messages, a hero, stats and a call to action, must share one compact grid.
avoid: Rows are fixed at 280px and every tile is hardcoded to the hiking theme.
a11y: The Join Now tile is a div with a pointer cursor, so it cannot be focused or reached by keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale page holding a rounded grid of tiles: a large mountain photo washed in blue with a Live Adventures pill, a tall blue stat tile reading 2,847, and a white Instant Routes card. Dark and blue tiles begin a second row below.
behaves: Static in the recording: the tiles do not move. In the code the mountain photo zooms slightly and the Join Now arrow circle rotates on hover, while a dot on the community stat keeps pulsing.
customise: Copy, numbers, image URL and gradient stops are inline in the JSX; the 280px row height is set on the grid.
weight: light: A static grid with CSS hover zooms and one pulsing dot.
demo: 'Explore Beyond Boundaries' headline, 2,847 Peaks Conquered, Instant Routes and a mountain photo.
issues: The second row is cut off by the recording, so the bento is never seen whole.
The Join Now tile looks clickable but is a plain div with no keyboard access.
polishWhy: Rich blue gradients and a strong photo tile; the small stat labels are faint.

frames.note: The second row of tiles is cut off by the recording, showing only its top edge.
